svg.title: Knowledge graph: how Dhodraj Sundaram's engineering ideas connect
svg.desc: A knowledge graph with Dhodraj Sundaram at the centre, joined to six domains. Reasoning: First principles; Second-order effects; What not to build; Simplicity first; Evidence over assumption. Systems: Concurrency; Backend architecture, interest with nothing public yet; Operating systems, interest with nothing public yet; Distributed systems, interest with nothing public yet; Networking, interest with nothing public yet. Tools and AI: Agent orchestration; Semantic code search; Typed libraries; Research automation, started. Open source: Published packages; Design docs in the open. Learning: Technical writing; Measured results; How mechanisms work, interest with nothing public yet. Product: Problem definition; Scope cuts; Architecture trade-offs. Labelled links: First principles to Backend architecture, informs; Concurrency to Agent orchestration, informs; Measured results to Scope cuts, sets; What not to build to Scope cuts, drives; Open source to Learning, shared learning. Callouts: inverse thinking find the failure modes first, then decide what not to build; systems first understand how the machine runs before choosing the tool; tools turn an insight that keeps coming back into a workflow. A footer lists how decisions are made: first principles, second-order effects, inverse thinking, simplicity, evidence and goals.

g.text: then decide what not to build

text.tspan: find failure modes and what not to build
the simplest thing that meets the need

svg.text: States show public evidence, not skill level. Repositories and figures are listed in the README, where they can change without redrawing this graph.
